en: A sepia-toned, vintage postcard image depicting a large public square with manicured gardens, benches, and people strolling or sitting. The square is surrounded by ornate, historic European architecture, including a domed building and classical facades. The text 'Libau, Der Rosenplatz' appears in the upper left corner, and the lower right displays the words 'Cikusi Latvija.'
